body: Komi Store is growing, so - we are building a small the team of maintainers. Komi Store just passed 72 open issues and 16k+ stars - and one person currently needs to maintain it all ^^. We would like to bring a small team to help review changes, participate in issues and communities. If you are developer or community manager - open the latest blog post on the Komi Store website for details.
title: Komi Store is growing
